findings.message: Variant at `$['data']['hasVariant'][1]` has no `url`, but other variants in the same ProductGroup declare one.
findings.remediation: Add a `url` to this variant matching its distinct addressable page state, consistent with its siblings. If this variant genuinely shares the exact same URL as the others with no parameter-based differentiation (case 1 in the spec), the per-variant `url` should instead be omitted from *all* entries so presence is uniform.
